prompt:
ONE single pose of a 2D game character, ONE cell, side profile facing RIGHT, on a PURE BLACK background, nothing else in the image.

PROPORTIONS — THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT: squat heroic GAME SPRITE proportions. The head is nearly ONE QUARTER of the total height. Compact, thick, chunky — like a 16-bit Castlevania sprite blown up. NOT realistic anatomy, NOT slender 7-heads-tall illustration proportions. If the figure looks like a fashion illustration, it is WRONG.

THE CHARACTER, side profile facing RIGHT unless a pose says otherwise: a lean athletic cyberpunk death god.
- A bright red #E01F26 hannya oni mask covering the ENTIRE face, narrow white glowing eye slits, a fanged white grin, a small cyan third eye on the forehead.
- Two red horns swept BACKWARD from the temples, never up or forward.
- A very long ponytail banded deep indigo #1E33D9 at the root through electric blue #2B6FE8 to bright cyan #35C6F4 at the tip.
- A BROAD PURE WHITE SLEEVELESS captain's haori with a torn ragged hem.
  THE HAORI IS THE MOST IMPORTANT GARMENT AND THE ONE MOST OFTEN FORGOTTEN. It must be LARGE, WHITE and UNMISTAKABLE in ALL 30 CELLS WITHOUT EXCEPTION. He never takes it off. He does not remove it to run, to fight, to jump, to fall or to kneel. When he runs it STREAMS OUT BEHIND HIM as a big white shape — it does not disappear. A cell without a large white haori is a FAILED cell.
- A black tracksuit jacket with acid-green #C6F02A and cyan racing stripes. The SLEEVES ARE ROLLED TO THE ELBOWS: below the elbow his BARE FOREARMS AND HANDS are DEEP BROWN SKIN (#855434 base, #4A2A1A shadow, #B07A4A highlight). He is a Black man. Forearms and hands must be BROWN SKIN — never dark fabric, never grey, never pale, never gloved.
- Black hakama trousers gathered at the ankles, black tabi boots.
- A katana and wakizashi in black scabbards at his LEFT hip.


HORNS: both horns sweep BACKWARD from the temples like a comet's tail, hugging low over the hair. NEVER pointing up. NEVER curving forward.

THE POSE — HITEN MITSURUGI RYU BATTOJUTSU STANCE (the coil before the god-speed draw, Rurouni Kenshin style): crouched VERY LOW, front knee deeply bent, back leg extended, torso twisted forward over the front knee. His LEFT hand grips the katana's SAYA (scabbard) AT HIS LEFT HIP, tilting it forward; his RIGHT hand hovers ON the hilt. THE BLADE IS FULLY SHEATHED — no steel visible anywhere, ONLY the black scabbard. The white haori and ponytail hang settled and dead still: total stillness loaded with violence.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels, hard aliased edges, 1-pixel dark outline on every shape, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. 16-bit Castlevania Symphony of the Night style.
